description:
Min-Jae, an ordinary college student, is swindled by his only friend. Just as he’s about to lose everything, including his organs, with no family to turn to! A third-generation heir to a conglomerate, who claims to be Min-Jae’s first love, appears and saves him. But his joy is short-lived. It turns out he wasn’t his real first love after all... On top of that, for some strange reason, Min-Jae finds himself engaging in shameless flirtation whenever he meets Il-Hyeop.

Will Min-jae be able to keep up the charade until the end without getting caught?

 *“I’m supposed to be taking advantage of this third-generation chaebol heir... so why do I keep turning into a pervert?”*

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
